about_the_game:
This DLC adds 4 more civilizations to 4X4 PROGRESS!
Enjoy the atmosphere and game style of the newly added civilizations, and progress from the Stone Age to the Modern Era once again.

Includes 4 new civilizations.

  • Netherland: A civilization that reclaims land and produces resources. Unique tiles include Windmills and the East India Company.
  • Babylon: A civilization that snowballs with advanced science and technology in the Stone Age. Unique tiles include Hanging Gardens and Ishtar Gate.
  • Indonesia: A civilization that uses the sea on a limited land area made up of archipelagos. Unique tiles include Bells and Candi Ventar.
  • Italy: A civilization that lets you enjoy the prosperity of the Roman Empire through tight city design. Unique tiles include the Aqueduct, Colosseum and Forum Romano.
